name: Amaterasu (Radiance of the Eternal Dawn)
description: In her phoenix form, Amaterasu rises with celestial elegance, clad in the traditional regalia of the Japanese sun goddess. Her face, a graceful fusion of avian majesty and divine femininity, is painted in the ceremonial style of ancient Japan. Iridescent wings stretch from her sides like the horizon ablaze, as she holds a sacred mirror and ceremonial fan. Adorned with a radiant sun-headdress and layered kimono of crimson and gold, she is the eternal light reborn in sacred flame.
